svg.title: Yellow Curve
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Confirmed Foundation 1962 Tooth installation photo labels Yellow CurveEK293, above fireplace; corresponds to Christie exhibition provenance. Tall rounded yellow figure lies on white rectangular ground. Photographic skew removed approximately.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-2/; record christies-5315261; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
